segments.name: Semiconductor products
segments.description: Designs, develops, manufactures and markets mixed-signal microcontrollers, development tools, analog, connectivity and memory products for distributors and OEMs.
segments.evidence: In the semiconductor products segment, the Company designs, develops, manufactures and markets mixed-signal microcontrollers, development tools and analog, interface, mixed-signal, timing, wired and wireless connectivity devices, and memory products.

segments.name: Technology licensing
segments.description: Sells and licenses the Company's intellectual property, including SuperFlash and other non-volatile memory technologies, to foundries, manufacturers and design partners.
segments.evidence: The technology licensing segment includes sales and licensing of the Company's intellectual property.

revenueModel.text: The Company earns net sales from selling semiconductor products to distributors and OEMs, and earns license fees and royalties from licensing its technologies.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company sells its products to distributors and OEMs in a broad range of market segments, performs on-going credit evaluations of its customers and, as deemed necessary, may require collateral, primarily letters of credit.
